name: mcp-skylos
description: Skylos MCP server exposes static analysis as tools for AI coding agents — scan any Python, TypeScript, or Go codebase for dead code, security vulnerabilities, and quality issues directly from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client. Returns findings with file paths, line numbers, and severity so agents can auto-fix issues in context.
